_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Comparing your résumé with the job on Seeker

annotations.title: Check résumé against a job posting

description: Use when the user shares their résumé text AND one job description and asks how well they fit that job or what is missing. Sends both texts to Seeker (seekerscore.com), which compares the skills in each and returns the skill overlap percentage, the matched skills, the required and preferred skills the résumé does not show, and whether the experience level looks under, at or over the posting. It is a skills comparison, not a prediction of interviews or hiring.

job_description.description: The full text of the job posting, 200 to 20000 characters.

resume_text.description: The full plain text of the user's résumé, 200 to 50000 characters. Phone number and home address can be left out.

name: check_resume_against_job
title: Check résumé against a job posting
